Registration fee: R$ 30,00
**There will be a limit of 2 guests per competitor.**
Competitor limit: 60


REGISTRO
A participação nessa competição requer do competidor o conhecimento dos seguintes requisitos:

Estar familiarizado com o Regulamento da WCA;
Se inscrever através do site da WCA, realizar o pagamento de forma antecipada e mandar o comprovante para o organizador através do e-mail (bahiacubomagico@gmail.com) indicando o nome completo do participante. Detalhes sobre o pagamento da inscrição abaixo.

Aguardar até que o registro eletrônico seja aceito. Caso não participe mesmo com o pagamento, não haverá devolução do dinheiro. Serão aceitas inscrições no dia da competição para as modalidades 3x3, no valor de R$ 40,00;
Há um limite de 60 competidores
Outras informações adicionais verifique no site da WCA ou entre em contato com o organizador através do e-mail (bahiacubomagico@gmail.com).

REGISTRATION
The participation in this competition requires the comprehension and acceptance of the following requirements:

Register through the WCA website, pay in advance and send proof to the organizer via email (bahiacubomagico@gmail.com) indicating the participant's full name. More details about the payment below;

Wait for your registration to be approved online. In the case of not participating and having already paid the registration, no money will be returned. Registrations will be accepted on the day of the competition for 3x3 events at the cost of R$ 40,00;
There will be a limit of 60 competitors.
For additional information, check the WCA website or contact the organizer via email, (bahiacubomagico@gmail.com)

items.name: Cubestuff Challenge Q1 2024
items.information:
## SPECTATORS

Competitors are welcome to bring up to **two** spectators with them.

## VOLUNTEERING

Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8). 


## SPONSORSHIP

A big thanks to [Cubestuff](https://cubestuff.co.za/) who are sponsoring the prizes for this competition. They will have a stall set up at the venue for you to buy the different speedcubes they have on offer.

## VENUE HEAT 
This is an indoor venue with fans, but no aircon. It might get quite warm if we have a hot weekend. Please be aware of this, bring enough water, and make any preparations needed.

#### About CubingZA

Competitions in South Africa have exploded since the end of COVID, and interest is only getting stronger. CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country.

items.name: Barely Awake Boulder 2024
items.information:
We are excited to welcome competitors back to Boulder for the first time since 2016, and for the second ever 24+ hour competition held in North America!

Please make sure to read all tabs before registering. These tabs include important information regarding your responsibilities as a competitor and are very important!

This competition has a 150 competitor limit. Please try to limit your guests that you bring to the competition!
Competitions fill quickly, so it is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot.

Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations. If this is your first official competition, this video will provide you with most of the information you need. https://youtu.be/dPL3eV-A0ww
If this is your first competition, please be present 15 minutes before the competitor tutorial at 11:00 AM, which means you should plan to arrive at 10:45 AM.

If you are unable to make the competition, please withdraw your registration as soon as possible by emailing the organizing team, to ensure competitors on the waitlist can compete. You will receive a 50 percent refund if you drop before the withdrawal deadline of (2024-01-20 00:00 UTC)
